summary: Fixed empty recurrence_rule serialization bug (non-recurring events emitted invalid RRULE: line), added EXDATE processing to the recurring master update path, and replaced the outdated put_recurring_event_fails_400 test with 5 T14 acceptance tests covering series round-trip, modified/deleted occurrence persistence, unsupported RRULE rejection, and ETag determinism.
follow_up: The event_service.update method deletes all recurrence exceptions when the master is updated; this is correct when timing changes but means a client must re-send all EXDATEs and modified occurrences in the same PUT. This is consistent with RFC 4791 but worth documenting in the supported recurrence matrix (T14 handoff).
important_context: The recurrence_rule column can contain an empty string (not just NULL) for non-recurring events; the ical_and_etag function now filters this out. The EXDATE-on-update path uses event.version+1 as the expected_version for delete_occurrence calls, which works because event_service.update bumps the version by 1.
